label.en: IKJON · From Uzbekistan to the world

text.en: IKJON is a growing family of education, sport and health projects. We help people learn, train and recover, one step at a time.
text.uz: IKJON — ta'lim, sport va sog'liq yo'nalishidagi loyihalar oilasi. Biz odamlarga o'rganish, mashq qilish va tiklanishga yordam beramiz — bosqichma-bosqich, har kuni.

label.en: injury recovery plans in Joint Rehab

title.uz: Bitta brend, bir-biriga ulangan to'rt yo'nalish

text.en: Each area works like one gear in our logo: they turn together. New services are added here step by step as they are ready.
text.uz: Har bir yo'nalish bitta tishli g'ildirakdek: ular birgalikda aylanadi. Yangi xizmatlar shu yerga bosqichma-bosqich qo'shiladi.

text.en: IKJON Education & Consulting Centre prepares students for university and work with the knowledge and certificates they need.
text.uz: IKJON Education & Consulting Centre talabalarni universitet va ishga kerakli bilim va sertifikatlar bilan tayyorlaydi.

text.en: We bring young people together through football tournaments and competitions. Our GearBox_23 channel shares football training.
text.uz: Futbol turnirlari va tanlovlar orqali yoshlarni birlashtiramiz. GearBox_23 kanali futbol mashg'ulotlarini ulashadi.

text.en: Free, research-based apps for injury recovery, joint health and everyday fitness. Private by design: no account and no tracking.
text.uz: Tadqiqotlarga asoslangan bepul ilovalar: jarohatdan tiklanish, bo'g'imlar salomatligi va kundalik mashqlar.

text.en: We build the tools we use ourselves, then make them ready for other learning centres and teams.
text.uz: O'zimiz ishlatadigan vositalarni boshqa o'quv markazlari va jamoalar uchun ham tayyorlaymiz.

title.uz: Har bir detal o'z ma'nosiga ega

text.en: Gears only turn together. That is how IKJON is built: education, sport and health as one working system, pushing in one direction.
text.uz: Tishli g'ildiraklar bir-birisiz aylanmaydi. Shuning uchun IKJON ta'lim, sport va sog'liqni bitta tizim sifatida quradi.

text.en: Daily progress: one lesson, one training session, one exercise.
text.uz: Har kungi qadamlar: dars, mashg'ulot, bitta mashq.

text.en: Real results: a certificate, a new skill, a recovered knee.
text.uz: Haqiqiy natija: sertifikat, yangi ko'nikma, tiklangan sog'liq.

text.en: Balance and planning: the right programme and the right tool at the right time.
text.uz: Muvozanat va reja: to'g'ri dastur, to'g'ri vosita, to'g'ri vaqtda.

text.en: Never a straight line, but always upward, for our people and for the brand.
text.uz: Tekis chiziq emas, lekin doim yuqoriga: odamlar uchun ham, brend uchun ham.

text.en: Our apps open in any phone or computer browser, install like a normal app and keep working offline.
text.uz: Ilovalarimiz telefon yoki kompyuter brauzerida ochiladi, o'rnatiladi va internetsiz ham ishlaydi.

text.en: Day-by-day plans to recover from sports injuries and keep every joint healthy.
text.uz: Sport jarohatlaridan tiklanish va bo'g'imlar salomatligi uchun kunma-kun rejalar.

points.en: 113 exercises with photo and animated demos
points.uz: 113 ta mashq, foto va animatsiya bilan

points.en: No account, no ads, no tracking
points.uz: Hisob yo'q, reklama yo'q, kuzatuv yo'q

text.en: Grammar, IELTS preparation, vocabulary and Kids English
text.uz: Grammatika, IELTS tayyorlov, lug'at va bolalar ingliz tili

text.en: Daily skill sessions and a 30-day plan
text.uz: Kunlik mashg'ulotlar va 30 kunlik reja

text.en: Exercise library by body part
text.uz: Tana qismlari bo'yicha mashqlar kutubxonasi

text.en: Students, payments and attendance for learning centres
text.uz: O'quv markazlari uchun talabalar, to'lovlar va davomat

title.en: Trust is built step by step

text.en: Four rules we follow in everything we make.
text.uz: Har bir loyihamizda to'rtta qoidaga amal qilamiz.

text.en: Our health plans follow published research and show the studies behind them.
text.uz: Sog'liq ilovalarimiz e'lon qilingan tadqiqotlarga asoslanadi va har bir reja manbasini ko'rsatadi.

text.en: No account needed and no tracking. Your data stays on your own device.
text.uz: Hisob shart emas, kuzatuv yo'q. Ma'lumotlaringiz o'z qurilmangizda qoladi.

text.en: Our apps never replace a doctor or a teacher, and they say so clearly.
text.uz: Ilovalarimiz shifokor o'rnini bosmaydi va buni ochiq aytadi.

text.en: Every service is tested in our own centre first, then opened to everyone.
text.uz: Har bir xizmat avval o'zimizda sinovdan o'tadi, so'ng hammaga ochiladi.

text.en: For courses, events, partnerships or questions about our apps, message us on Telegram or Instagram.
text.uz: Kurslar, tadbirlar, hamkorlik yoki ilovalar bo'yicha savollar uchun bizga Telegram yoki Instagram orqali yozing.
